formulas.ascii: z_b = sum_j w_j (x_j - mean) / (S sqrt(Delta_b)) over the valid bins j of the cell neighbourhood in the current and temporalWindow previous slices, Delta_b = (n S1 - W^2)/(n - 1), with S the population standard deviation of all n valid bins, W = sum w_j and S1 = sum w_j^2 (binary lattice weights: S1 = W = k, the bins counted). NaN when n < 2, S = 0 or Delta_b <= 0. Per cell, Mann-Kendall S = sum over slice pairs i < j of sign(z_j - z_i) with tie-corrected variance, Z = (S - sign(S)) / sqrt(Var). A bin is hot (cold) when its two-sided normal p-value, adjusted over all valid bins by pCorrection, is at most 1 - confidenceLevel and z > 0 (z < 0). The 17 categories then follow from the hot and cold slice counts and the trend.
